description: Injected taps open System, inspect and cancel Power off, then inspect and cancel Reboot. Neither action executes in this clip.

review.visual_review: Reviewed camera frames near 1, 8, 15, and 23 seconds: System, Power off, and Reboot confirmation screens plus the return state are visible. Camera glare and the oblique view soften text; native screenshots are readable.
